rows.corpus_definition: To guess the size or cost of something using numbers.
rows.example_en: Can you estimate how long the trip takes?

rows.corpus_definition: Relating to what is morally right and good.
rows.example_en: It is not an ethical way to treat people.

rows.corpus_definition: To judge the quality or value of something carefully.
rows.example_en: We need to evaluate the results of the test.

rows.corpus_definition: Divided into parts that are all the same size.
rows.example_en: Divide the money evenly among the three children.

rows.corpus_definition: Happening at the end of a long process.
rows.example_en: The team worked hard for their eventual victory.

rows.corpus_definition: To develop gradually over a long period of time.
rows.example_en: How did these animals evolve over time?

rows.corpus_definition: to make something seem bigger or worse than it really is
rows.example_en: He always exaggerates how difficult his job is.

rows.corpus_definition: to go beyond a limit or be greater than a number
rows.example_en: Your spending must not exceed the monthly budget limit.

rows.corpus_definition: something that does not follow the general rule
rows.example_en: Every rule has at least one exception.

rows.corpus_definition: to carry out or complete a plan, task, or order
rows.example_en: The team executed the plan perfectly without any mistakes.
